mapper.select: SELECT invitation_id AS invitationId, tenant_id AS tenantId, email, role_key AS roleKey, token, status, invited_by AS invitedBy, created_at AS createdAt, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM invitations WHERE token = #{token} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invitations(tenant_id, email, role_key, token, invited_by, expires_at) VALUES(#{tenantId}, #{email}, #{roleKey}, #{token}, #{invitedBy}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT i.invitation_id AS invitationId, i.tenant_id AS tenantId, i.email, i.role_key AS roleKey, i.status, i.invited_by AS invitedBy, u.username AS invitedByUsername, i.created_at AS createdAt, i.expires_at AS expiresAt FROM invitations i LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = i.invited_by WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY i.invitation_id DESC
